description: Destination regions per cross-region inference profile an arm's pool uses (ENT-606, BR3.2, TS-U6-4). Read by infra/delphi_infra/grants.py to grant each arm foundation-model invoke in every region its profiles route to. Outside the image build context, so editing it never moves the image. destination_regions are those documented for source_region; a deploy from another source region confirms or corrects them with PROFILE-ROUTING-CONFIRM first (docs/deployment.md, S6). read_date is the date of the operator's read-only PROFILE-ROUTING-CONFIRM and is null until that read is relayed; source is what the regions were taken from until then.
